fact: The Gambia relies on a single ACE submarine cable landing at Brusubi (service from December 2012), with a costly terrestrial back-up route to Senegal run by Gamtel and Sonatel/Orange and no second cable or separate landing station yet, while ACE capacity is offered on open-access terms by the Gambia Submarine Cable Company to its members and newer players.
title: The Gambia Digital Economy Diagnostic
